j1.hard_blocker_review: None found. I checked the delivered audio_report: I=-13.71 against a -14 target, TP=-2.64 against a -1.0 ceiling, and speech_priority passes with a minimum margin of 18.0 dB. The music credit is on screen at 131.8s: "ICE FLOW" KEVIN MACLEOD (INCOMPETECH.COM) LICENSED UNDER CC BY 4.0. Captions: 36 cues run from 0.0 to 123.24s. The only uncaptioned stretch, 4.7 to 6.06s, is a VO gap. Every caption I read in the stills and strips matches caption_cues.json word for word. I found no typo in any plate I transcribed, including AS SMALL AS 2 PIXELS, MAY BE 7,000 TO 9,000 ANIMALS, ONE OF THESE IS A SEAL, 10X+ FASTER THAN A PERSON AT A MICROSCOPE, DUE TO THE PRESIDENT NOT PUBLIC YET, NOTHING ON THE PAGE SHOWS SMARTER and A BIGGER NAME. The numbers on screen match the VO. Palette: violet thermal, ice blue and wood brown; the blue is there for a reason (sea ice). preflight.py was not run inside this pack, so I could not check that blocker myself.
concrete_defects: 39.8s and 114.1s (f039.8, f114.1): a translucent rectangle sits over the gold SUPER INTELLIGENCE plate. It looks like a mis-sized glare or highlight layer. It washes out 'SUPER' and leaves a hard-edged pale box hanging off the lower right of the plate at 114.1s.
114.1s (f114.1): a lone coral detector-box corner bracket floats in empty sky to the left of the pod, around x270 y720. It is left over from the beat-42 box that springs open.
35.85s (filmstrip_a_gold_stamp_17, frame 8): the stamp body covers the middle of the word, so the plate reads 'SUPER IN_LLIGENCE' for a frame or two. Hold the reveal until the stamp clears.

19.0-23.6s (filmstrip_an_analyst_at_a_desk_10, measured 5.7% change): the analyst is effectively frozen, with no breath, weight shift or magnifier move across 8 frames. His face is hidden by the hat, and his body and head carry a pale vertical streak overlay (f024.4) that reads as a render artifact, not a rim light. He is plainer than the props around him.
0.2-1.4s (filmstrip_two_orange_pixels_1, measured 1.4% change): the first second is a static violet frame with a blinking pixel pair. The scroll stop rests on the caption text, not on motion.

83-103s, shot 11-12 signpost floe (filmstrips 33-40, measured 2.3-5.7% change): about 20 seconds on one locked symmetric frame with only small head turns from the seal. This is the film's saggiest stretch.
18.3s (f018.3): a lighter translucent panel covers the right third of the tile wall (edge near x965), and the ONE OF THESE IS A SEAL card partly hides an orange dot tile.
73.2s (f073.2): faint SUPER INTELLIGENCE browser tiles show through behind the caption plate at y~1415, and the tile grid has an empty slot in its top row.
Audio: 4 of 25 VO gaps are digital quiet under -55 dBFS (19.48s, 29.82s, 82.12s, 103.24s). The ambience bed drops out there, and the only ambience layers are synthesised brown noise.
top_3_fixes: Remove the stray glare rectangle on the gold plate (39.8s, 114.1s) and the orphan coral bracket at 114.1s. Gate the stamp reveal so the plate never shows a cut-off word (35.85s).

Give the analyst (19-24s) idle life: breath, a head bob over the magnifier, a hand move. Remove the streak overlay on his figure. Break up the 83-103s signpost floe with one more motivated move, for example snow drift across the signs, the pod swaying, or the seal shuffling.
Run the ambience bed continuously so no VO gap falls below -55 dBFS (19.48, 29.82, 82.12, 103.24s), and add one motivated foley layer (wind on the plates, the chain clink) under the floe scenes.

j2.drift_note: No axis moved by more than 1.0 from my cut 2 card. j2.hard_blocker_review: Audio: I=-13.71 against a -14 target, TP=-2.64 under the -1.0 ceiling (more headroom than cut 2's -1.38), speech_priority pass with an 18.0 dB minimum margin. The music credit is on the credits card ('ICE FLOW' Kevin MacLeod, CC BY 4.0). caption_cues.json has 37 cues tracking the VO, and they are legible in every still. On-screen numbers and dates match the captions. No cultural content. ONE ITEM FOR THE ORCHESTRATOR TO CHECK AGAINST preflight: filmstrip_the_two_pages_32 (centre 81.2s) shows the dark 'TWO VIEWS' plate sitting ON TOP of the gold 'SAME LEGAL DEFINITION' plate in all eight frames, covering the top of its letters. That is type on type. preflight's plate_overlap_check is not in the pack. If preflight flags it, it is a hard blocker under clause 1. If preflight passes it as a sub-second handover, it is still a visible defect, and I have charged it to Typography and Composition rather than calling a blocker I can't confirm.
concrete_defects: Shot 10, about 80.9-81.5s (filmstrip_the_two_pages_32): the 'TWO VIEWS' plate overlaps the gold 'SAME LEGAL DEFINITION' plate and cuts across its cap-height. Fix: clear the gold plate before 'TWO VIEWS' enters, or put 'TWO VIEWS' lower, as cut 1 did at f080.0.

Audio, 19.48s, 29.82s, 82.12s, 103.24s: four gaps measure below the -55 dBFS dead-air floor (quietest -59.6), up from 3 in cut 2 and 1 in cut 1. I accept the stated cause (the speech-priority release can't recover inside sub-second gaps) and grade what is measured: digital silence four times, one of them right after the dean's line lands. Fix: add a gap-aware release, or a separate ungated room-tone layer under the speech-priority stage at about -45 dBFS that the ducker does not touch.

Shot 4, 18.8-23.7s (filmstrip_an_analyst_at_a_desk_10, measured 5.7%, was 5.4%): the 'stronger lean and breath' still does not read at strip scale. Across eight frames the figure is effectively unchanged, and the visible deltas are the wall print and the mug steam. Fix: a lean of 6-10 px toward the magnifier, with a breath of 3% scale on the torso, eased over about 1.5s.

Shot 12, 100.9-103.2s (filmstrip_the_ringedseal_39, 3.3%; filmstrip_the_ringedseal_40, 4.3%; both essentially unchanged from cut 2): the 'wider head turn with holds' is not visible. The head tilts a few pixels at most and never clearly addresses either board. Fix: rotate the head 25-35 degrees to the left board, hold, then to the right board, hold. If the rig can't rotate, swap to a three-quarter head drawing.

Shot 5, 30.4s (f030.4): the heat is now aligned and the corner streak is gone, but a grey translucent ellipse still sits over the seal's head inside the detector box, and a soft white blur remains under the 'DEVELOPED WITH MICROSOFT AI' plate. Fix: remove both leftover overlay layers.

Ending, 122.0-123.9s (f122.0, f123.9): the '11-28' numeral still floats alone top right on the violet field with no plate or label, so it reads as stray text. The end frame is also mostly empty. Fix: anchor '11-28' to a labelled counter (for example 'DEFINITION DUE') or drop it, and stage the ring a little larger and higher.
Typography system-wide: every plate and caption is still in the JetBrains mono face, with no Fraunces display face on the hero plates. Fix: set 'SUPER INTELLIGENCE' and 'A BIGGER NAME' in Fraunces.
top_3_fixes: Resolve the 'TWO VIEWS' / 'SAME LEGAL DEFINITION' plate collision at 81.2s, and confirm plate_overlap_check passes on the new cut.
Put an ungated room-tone layer under the speech-priority stage so none of the four gaps (19.48s, 29.82s, 82.12s, 103.24s) falls below -55 dBFS.
Make the two held-figure performances readable: the analyst's lean and breath (shot 4) and the seal's sign-to-sign head turn with holds (shot 12). Both strips are unchanged from cut 2.
